name: Moonlit Jade Garden
concept: An original enchanted garden under a luminous moon, refined botanical fantasy for an elegant smartphone visual set
style: Premium hand-painted ornamental fantasy, layered deep teal and jade, luminous ivory accents, fine gold filigree, delicate organic linework, cohesive composition and no text
